verses.text: Sing a new song to the LORD! Sing to the LORD, all the earth.
Sing to the LORD and praise his name! Tell every day how he saves!
Tell the nations about his glory. Tell all peoples about the amazing things he does.
The LORD is great and deserves great praise! He should be feared more than all gods.
All the gods of the nations are just idols, but the LORD made the skies.
Honour and majesty are all around him. Strength and beauty fill his holy place.
Give honour to the LORD, all you families of the nations. Give honour to the LORD for his glory and strength.
Give the LORD the glory his name deserves. Bring an offering and come into his courtyards.
Worship the LORD in the beauty of holiness. Tremble in front of him, all the earth.
Tell the nations, "The LORD rules!" The world is firmly in place. It cannot be moved. He will judge the peoples fairly.
Let the skies be glad and the earth celebrate! Let the sea and everything in it roar!
Let the fields and everything in them be full of joy! Then all the trees of the forest will sing for joy
in front of the LORD, because he is coming. He is coming to judge the earth. He will judge the world fairly and the peoples with his truth.
